title: DC-area forecast: A nice start to the weekend, before storms return Sunday
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Plenty of sunshine today with highs climbing into the mid- to upper 80s. There's a touch of humidity, but nothing out of the ordinary for mid-August.

What’s next? Sunday looks to be the wettest day through midweek, with storm chances lingering into Monday. Tuesday and Wednesday look dry, with some humidity relief.

Today’s daily digit — 7/10: Pretty typical August conditions today. Mostly sunny with a touch of humidity, but overall a quiet summer day. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Saturday): Mostly sunny skies, with highs reaching the mid- to upper 80s. Dew points in the mid- to upper 60s will make it feel a bit humid, but slightly less so than recent days. Winds are light, starting from the northeast before shifting to out of the southeast around midday. Confidence: Medium-High

Tonight: Partly cloudy this evening as temperatures fall back to near 80. Increasing clouds overnight with lows dipping into the upper 60s to low 70s and showers possible toward morning. Confidence: Medium

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Sunday): It shouldn’t rain continuously but showers are possible in the morning before storm chances increase during the afternoon, a few of which could be strong. Mostly cloudy skies limit highs to the upper 70s to mid-80s with high humidity. Winds come from the south around 15 mph, with higher gusts in storms. Confidence: Medium

Tomorrow night: Showers and storms remain possible well into the evening. Skies stay mostly cloudy through the night, with muggy lows dipping into the low to mid-70s. Confidence: Medium

Our morning forecast email is back! It's included with every level of support — from Free to Sustainer — delivered 7 days a week. Sign up at: capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

Partly sunny on Monday with highs in the upper 80s and low 90s. It remains humid and a few lingering showers and storms are possible, mainly during the afternoon. Confidence: Medium

Tuesday is when we should start to see some gradual relief from the humidity. It's mostly sunny with highs in the mid-80s to near 90. Expect similar conditions on Wednesday. Confidence: Medium

DC weather history for August 15

A brutal 1988 heat wave peaked at a record 103 degrees before a violent thunderstorm swept through, knocking out power to tens of thousands and turning the sky dark with intense lightning and torrential rain.
